payload.title: Improve Auritus through the VideoML integration
payload.description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given reusable speech capability gaps exposed by VideoML, when implemented, then fixes belong in Auritus rather than a forked model backend inside VideoML. Provide a stable programmatic speech interface, capability discovery, completion/error metadata, and integration fixtures; file linked Auritus issues before product changes. Keep website extraction optional for direct text synthesis.

## Ownership
specification, toolchain, cli, player, videoml-org; Auritus owns reusable model backends

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
